title: Idolatry of Kill'em Klarkzon
description: Idolatry of Kill'em Klarkzon — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chuck McBarris

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay Kill'em Klarkzon in Deathtroit

Quest Reward: 22500 Gold

Return to: Chuck McBarris

Repeatable: Unknown

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head into Deathtroit which is found off of the first level of Frump's Misfortune. Find and kill Kill'em Klarkzon and then return to Chuck McBarris in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort

Offer:

Kill'em Klarkzon was our very first Dungeon Idol. We owe a great deal to their mayhem and mishaps for helping the show to gain its notoriety. However, that was at least five years ago and it's time for them to move on.

The problem is that wherever Kill'em goes, their little groupies are sure to follow. This is causing a great deal of anxiety and stress for the current contestants who now feel inadequate in the presence of one as famous as Kill'em. We have also noticed a slowing of the influx of Dungeon Runners traveling through Dethtroit ever since Kill'em Klarkzon's arrival. I don't have to pull out the ratings charts or have Nielsen go into one of his tirades about how bad we are doing.

We need for you to head into Deathtroit which is off of the first level of Frump's Misfortune. Once there, find and assist Kill'em Klarkzon in vacating the premises. Be wary of any groupies that may be swooning around Kill'em when you ask for them to leave. They are known to be quite the rabid fans. You know who your fan is? That's right, Chuck is! Return to Chuck in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when the Kill'em is no longer in the area.

Turn-in:

I hope they didn't put up a fuss or a fight. It sure would be embarrassing to be a former Dungeon Idol who is forcibly removed from their old stomping grounds.

I feel like I'm stuck in some sort of re-run. I am getting reports from our producers that another one of our former Idols is hanging about. The problem with this Idol is that they are refusing to give up their status as a Dungeon Idol. Let me know if you want to hunt them down and beat some sense into them.

Objectives:

  • Kill'em Klarkzon

Level range: 30–45
